deploy-bot: Starting deploy to canary for service=inference-api env=canary commit=4a3b2c1 tag=release/v2.14.0 initiated_by=@maya. CI gate running...
ci-gate-bot: CI gate report: 3 failing checks detected. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345 :warning:
maya: Ugh. Which checks?
ci-gate-bot: Failing checks:
```
- integration/kv-cache-flaky
- perf/latency-p95-regression
- e2e/streaming-output-validation
```
Full logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345/logs
sam: Thanks for the alert. Suggest we HOLD canary and pin prod to v2.13.3 until triage. :no_entry_sign:
jordan: Agree with hold. If perf is the blocker we might fallback to the quantized-variant as a short term mitigation. Need to call this out in release notes.
ops-oncall: Change window paused, marking release tracker as BLOCKED. Notifying oncall and affected PMs. https://internal/release/track/4021 :rotating_light:
maya: I'm triaging now — will repro locally and check the perf regression signal. @sam can you kick a rerun of the flaky integration test?
ci-gate-bot: Rerun queued by @sam — job #98765.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy paused — blocked by CI gate. tag release/v2.14.0 will not be promoted while gate is failing. Automatic resume will occur only if gate clears within maintenance window.
sam: Added a note to the release notes draft: "hold: CI failures (perf + integration). investigating."
maya: Opening issue RED-5421 for tracking, ETA ~30m for initial findings.
ci-gate-bot: Rerun complete: 2/3 checks passed, remaining failing check: perf/latency-p95-regression. Gate remains locked.
jordan: Given persistent perf failure, decision: abort canary attempt and rollback plan — pin production deployments to tag v2.13.3. We'll block any further promotions of v2.14.0 until root cause is fixed.
ops-oncall: Rollback scheduled: target tag=release/v2.13.3 commit=b1c2d3e window=2026-03-20T13:00:00Z. Stakeholders notified. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for canary: target=release/v2.13.3 commit=b1c2d3e. Deploy logs: https://deploy.internal/redwood/logs/abc. Canary for v2.14.0 remains blocked.
maya: Will post triage notes and link to any hotfix PRs in RED-5421 once available.
ci-gate-bot: Final status: gate=FAILED -> blocked. Next actions: triage issue created, rollback scheduled, release notes updated.
sam: Thanks everyone — good catch. We'll reconvene after triage and update the release plan. :thumbsup:
